name: se-ship-repair
title: Space Exploration: Ship Repair
author: LockeWatts
description: Your first spaceship is the one you crashed in. The wreck at the crash site becomes a repair site: restore its hull, systems and propulsion in three stages, and it is rebuilt on the spot as a working Space Exploration spaceship. Adds costly crude recipes that make spaceships buildable from rocket science; Space Exploration's own recipes are unchanged.
